reviewMethod: Direct official publisher program pages reviewed for links and brief original descriptions. Status and deadline are included only where the cited page supports them.

records.title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Master’s
records.summary: Research master's scholarship worth $27,000 for 12 months. Apply through an eligible Canadian university using the Research Portal; the published deadline is December 1 before 8 p.m. Eastern.
records.publisher: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada
records.termsReview: Link and independently written summary only; confirm NSERC-specific content rights before any reproduction.
records.statusEvidence: Official opportunity page labels the program Open and gives the December 1 deadline.

records.title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship – Doctoral
records.summary: Doctoral research scholarship worth $40,000 per year for 36 months. Application routes depend on enrolment; institutional deadlines can precede the agency's October 17 deadline.
records.publisher: Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada
records.termsReview: Link and independently written summary only; confirm NSERC-specific content rights before any reproduction.
records.statusEvidence: Official page lists an agency deadline but no single current status or institution-wide closing date.

records.title: B.C. Access Grant (Part-Time)
records.summary: Needs-based grant of up to $1,000 a year for qualifying part-time undergraduate study at a B.C. public institution. Assessment happens with the part-time student-aid application.
records.termsReview: Link and independently written summary only; no B.C. page text reproduced.
records.statusEvidence: Official page says the grant is assessed automatically with student aid and gives no standalone intake deadline.

records.title: B.C. Provincial Tuition Waiver Program
records.summary: May waive domestic tuition and eligible fees for current and former youth in care taking eligible study below graduate level. First-time applicants submit through an eligible school's financial aid office.
records.termsReview: Link and independently written summary only; no B.C. page text reproduced.
records.statusEvidence: Official page gives an application route without a current universal intake deadline.

records.title: B.C. Learning for Future Grant
records.summary: Annual $3,500 grant toward education costs for eligible Provincial Tuition Waiver Program students in qualifying study below graduate level. First-time applicants apply through their institution.
records.termsReview: Link and independently written summary only; no B.C. page text reproduced.
records.statusEvidence: Official page gives program-year and annual declaration rules but no universal closing date.

records.title: B.C. Supplemental Bursary for Students with Disabilities
records.summary: Non-repayable bursary for qualifying students with disabilities at B.C. public post-secondary schools. The amount depends on course load and federal disability-grant qualification.
records.termsReview: Link and independently written summary only; no B.C. page text reproduced.
records.statusEvidence: Official page refers applicants to the disability-funding process and gives no award closing date.

records.title: Canada Student Grant for Students with Disabilities
records.summary: Federal grant for qualifying full- or part-time students with a permanent or persistent disability. This B.C. delivery page gives the local disability-funding application route.
records.termsReview: Link and independently written summary only; no B.C. page text reproduced.
records.statusEvidence: Official B.C. program page gives the application route but no standalone closing date.

records.title: Ontario Learn and Stay Grant for Medical Education
records.summary: Covers eligible medical education costs for Ontario residents in first-year family medicine residency who agree to practise family medicine in Ontario for at least five years. Apply through OSAP.
records.termsReview: Ontario welcomes linking; independently written summary only, no page text copied.
records.statusEvidence: Official page updated September 17, 2026 explicitly says applications are now open, with no closing date shown.

records.title: Ontario Trillium Benefit
records.summary: Tax-free support for qualifying Ontario residents toward energy, sales tax, and property tax costs. Apply through the annual income-tax return and ON-BEN form.
records.termsReview: Ontario welcomes linking; independently written summary only, no page text copied.
records.statusEvidence: Official page describes annual tax filing, including late filing, not a finite program intake.

records.title: Ontario Trillium Drug Program
records.summary: Helps qualifying Ontario households with high prescription-drug costs relative to income. The official page links an online application and explains reimbursement timing.
records.termsReview: Ontario welcomes linking; independently written summary only, no page text copied.
records.statusEvidence: September 30 on the official page applies to reimbursement for the prior program year, not a general application closing date.
